Name: Awareness
Calculation applied: count(ownly_aware = True) / catchment = 17/40; Wilson 95% CI
Decision it serves: the reach vs conversion budget split.

Name: Trial penetration
Calculation applied: count(ownly_says_ordered = True) / catchment = 2/40
Why not computable: Base is 2 respondents; interval spans 1.4–16.5%. Directional only.
Decision it serves: whether to invest in acquisition or conversion.

Name: Awareness → trial conversion
Calculation applied: count(tried) / count(aware) = 2/17
Why not computable: Numerator is 2. Not interpretable as a conversion rate.
Decision it serves: fix the barriers first, or scale awareness.

Name: Browse → order conversion
Calculation applied: count(tried) / count(opened) = 2/7
Decision it serves: whether to fix what users see inside the app first.

Name: Repeat-active Ownly customers per 100 delivery users  project north-star proxy
Pre-registered formula: `count(S4-Q3 ≥ 1 AND S4-Q3 + S12-Q4 ≥ 2) ÷ count(eligible AND S3-Q3 = Yes) × 100`
Why not computable: North-star proxy needs repeat-active Ownly customers. Only 2 catchment respondents report any Ownly order and their order counts contradict their own other answers (see anomalies.csv). No survey question substitutes for observed repeat behaviour.
Decision it serves: the overall transferability call, always read against guardrails G1–G4.

Name: H₀ fake-door CTA conversion by arm
Pre-registered formula: `visitors with cta_click ÷ unique visitors`, per arm. Lift = `B − A` in pp, and `B/A − 1` relative.
Evidence label: observed intent (a click, not an order).
Why not computable: Fake-door experiment was designed, built and powered but never given traffic. Event log has 0 rows. decision_rules §1 therefore makes K14 the primary H0 test.
Decision it serves: reject or fail to reject H₀, and choose the lead proposition. Primary **only if ≥ 80 visitors and ≥ 30 per arm** (D3).

Name: H₀ survey forced choice: Service Q share
Pre-registered formula: `count(S7-Q3 = Q) ÷ count(S7-Q3 ∈ {P, Q})`. "Can't choose" is reported separately.
Calculation applied: count(prop_forced = Q) / count(prop_forced in P,Q) = 11/29. 'Can't choose' = 11 of 40 = 27.5%, reported separately per the pre-registered formula
Decision it serves: the H₀ call when the fake door is under-powered; the lead message for Hyderabad.

Name: Median matched-basket saving % vs the cheaper incumbent
Pre-registered formula: for each matched set, `(min(Swiggy, Zomato final_payable) − Ownly final_payable) ÷ min(Swiggy, Zomato)`; take the median across sets.
Calculation applied: (min(Swiggy,Zomato final_payable) − Ownly final_payable) / min(...) per matched set; median of [16.9, 27.5, 33.5, 52.6] = 30.5%. Median in rupees = ₹114.50. 95% CI by percentile bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, seed 20260921
Pre-registered source: audit captures (`final_payable`, matched on slot + restaurant_name + basket_id).
Decision it serves: KEEP/ADAPT/DROP price as the lead claim.

Name: Ownly win rate
Calculation applied: count(Ownly cheapest by more than ₹5) / matched sets = 4/4
Decision it serves: whether the price claim can be repeated.

Name: Fee load %
Pre-registered formula: `(packaging + platform + delivery + small_cart + surge) ÷ final_payable`, median per platform.
Calculation applied: non-food charges / final_payable, median across zero-discount priced captures. Ownly = 4.8% (n=4); incumbent pooled median = 23.0% (swiggy n=7, zomato n=13). Fee-load gap = 18.3 pp
Decision it serves: KEEP/ADAPT the "no fees" message.

Name: Switching-threshold coverage
Pre-registered formula: `count(S6-Q4 ₹ ≤ K20 median ₹) ÷ count(S6-Q4 numeric)`. "No amount" and "don't know" are shown separately.
Calculation applied: count(stated required saving ≤ K20 median of ₹114.50) / count(numeric answers) = 33/33. Held out and reported separately per the pre-registered formula: 'no amount' = 4, "don't know" = 3
Decision it serves: whether price can lead.

Name: ₹30 trade-off shares
Calculation applied: share choosing the ₹230 option at a constant ₹30 saving, by attribute sacrificed. speed 37/40 = 92.5%; reliability 29/40 = 72.5%; restaurants 14/40 = 35.0%
Decision it serves: lead with price, or with reliability/supply; tests "price gets the first order, reliability the second".

Name: Fee pain on the last bill
Pre-registered formula: `count(S5-Q4 = "No, the extra charges on top were too much") ÷ answered`
Calculation applied: count(bill_fairness = "No, the extra charges on top were too much") / answered = 14/36
Decision it serves: how prominent the no-fee message should be.

Name: Repeat-without-promo intent
Calculation applied: top-2 box on repeat-without-promo (score ≥ 4 of 5) / answered = 10/40
Decision it serves: promotion KEEP/MODIFY (read against K15).

Name: Stated trial intent, P vs Q (top-2 box)
Calculation applied: top-2 box trial intent on the better of Service P / Service Q per respondent = 37/40
Decision it serves: confidence in the direction of the H₀ result.

Name: Trier repeat rate
Why not computable: Trier repeat rate needs repeat behaviour among triers. Only 2 catchment respondents report an Ownly order, and one of those gives contradictory order counts. Base too small and internally inconsistent.
Decision it serves: GTM focus on retention vs acquisition.

Name: Unit share of requirements
Pre-registered formula: `Σ S4-Q3 ÷ Σ(S4-Q1..Q4)` over respondents with S4-Q3 > 0.
Why not computable: Unit share of requirements among Ownly users requires a usable Ownly order count; the only two are unusable.
Decision it serves: position Ownly as a main app or an occasional deal app.

Name: Target-restaurant coverage
Calculation applied: count(on_ownly = yes) / 10 audit-frame restaurants = 9/10
Decision it serves: supply-first vs demand-first.

Name: Local vs chain coverage gap
Why not computable: coverage(local) − coverage(chain) requires a local/chain flag on the restaurant frame. audit_coverage.csv carries no such column, so the gap cannot be computed without re-coding the frame.
Decision it serves: Service Q feasibility.

Name: Cross-platform availability overlap
Pre-registered formula: `count(open on Ownly AND on ≥1 incumbent) ÷ count(open on ≥1 incumbent)`
Calculation applied: count(on Ownly AND on ≥1 incumbent) / count(on Ownly) = 8/9
Decision it serves: operational supply fix.

Name: "My restaurants weren't there" barrier share
Calculation applied: count(reason mentions restaurants) / answered = 0/10
Why not computable: No respondent selected a missing-restaurants reason. The live instrument's answer list for this question does not appear to offer "My restaurants weren't there", so a 0% here measures the option list, not the barrier. Treated as NOT INFORMATIVE for the rule.
Decision it serves: supply priority.

Name: ETA gap
Pre-registered formula: median of `Ownly eta_mid − cheaper incumbent eta_mid`, where `eta_mid = (min + max) ÷ 2`
Calculation applied: median(Ownly shown ETA) − median(incumbent shown ETA) = 39.5 − 22.5 = +17.0 min
Decision it serves: whether ETA blocks the price proposition.

Name: Fulfilment failure incidence among triers
Why not computable: The pre-registered source is 'new question A3' (15+ min late / cancelled / missing or wrong item / refund or support over 2 days). No such question exists in the live v3 instrument — there is no A3 variable in cleaned_survey.csv. Guardrail G2 therefore cannot be evaluated.
Decision it serves: ADAPT (lead with and fix reliability) vs KEEP.

Name: Repeat rate by failure experience
Why not computable: Repeat rate by failure experience depends on K51 (absent) and on a usable trier base (n=2).
Decision it serves: the retention lever.

Name: Rapido usage penetration
Calculation applied: count(rapido_freq not in blank/Never) / catchment = 24/40
Decision it serves: Rapido cross-sell priority.

Name: Discovery via the Rapido app
Calculation applied: count(rapido_food_seen = "Yes") / answered excluding "I don't use the Rapido app" = 5/33. "Not sure" counted as not noticed, per the project convention
Decision it serves: Hyderabad channel mix.

Name: Awareness and trial gap, Rapido users vs non-users
Calculation applied: awareness(Rapido users) − awareness(non-users) = 33.3% (8/24) − 56.2% (9/16) = -22.9 pp. Conservative interval from the difference of the two Wilson bounds
Why not computable: Association, not causation. Both subgroups are small, so the interval on the difference is very wide.
Decision it serves: KEEP/ADAPT Rapido cross-sell.

Name: Discount as top trial trigger
Calculation applied: count(trigger = "A discount on my first order") / answered = 2/23. For comparison, "Seeing it's cheaper than Swiggy/Zomato" = 8/23 = 34.8% and is the top trigger
Decision it serves: promo vs price-proof message.

Name: Offer-triggered first order
Pre-registered formula: `count(A2 ∈ Yes options) ÷ count(A2 answered, excluding "Don't remember")`
Why not computable: Offer-triggered FIRST ORDER is defined among triers. Only 2 catchment respondents ordered; ownly_trigger is answered by non-triers as a hypothetical, so it cannot stand in.
Decision it serves: how much trial depends on promotion.

Name: Promo-dependency gap
Why not computable: Promo-dependency gap = repeat rate of organic triers − repeat rate of offer-acquired triers. Requires question A2 (acquisition channel) crossed with repeat behaviour among triers. A2 is absent from the live instrument and the trier base is 2. Guardrail G4 cannot be evaluated.
Decision it serves: promotion KEEP / MODIFY / TARGET / DEPRIORITIZE.
